changelog: 📁 Custom Folder Management System: Full custom folder creation and chat organization across the workspace while preserving the primary directory structure.

🎨 Redesigned Agent CLI Suite UI: Fixed squeezed size badge layouts, prevented ugly multi-line text wrapping ('Executio\nn', 'Progra\nmming'), and added DeepSeek Hermes CLI, OpenAI Codex CLI, and OpenRouter CLI suite packages.
🗑️ Permanent Chat Purge: Guaranteed disk removal of conversation artifacts (.pbtxt, .db, .lock) so deleted chats never resurrect on app restart.

🔑 Active Models Only Selector: Model picker in chat prompt bar strictly filters and displays only models with active credentials or logged-in accounts; inactive providers are tucked away into an unlock section.
⚡ 100% Working Direct APIs: Direct streaming support for Anthropic Claude (/v1/messages), OpenRouter with required headers, DeepSeek reasoner/chat routing, and OpenAI Codex routing.
☁️ Google Drive Cloud Vault: 1-Tap complete backup & restore of chats, media, projects, and application data to user's Google Drive.

🛠️ Expanded AI Suite & Creation Strip: Quick toggles for Personal Intelligence (ON/OFF), Deep Thinking mode, Web Search, Camera, Photo, File, Google Drive, NotebookLM, Create Photo/Video/Music, Canvas IDE, Deep Research, and Learning modes.

🤖 Autonomous GitHub Repo & Skill Installer Agent: Autonomous detection of GitHub repo links in chat, automatic clone into projects/, dependency installation via pnpm, and auto-registration of Antigravity skills.
